_help: Performance budgets for the Instagram tests on the shared dashboard (format: see the toolkit README and apps/egenome/test/budgets.json).
Going over a budget gives a WARNING, never a failed run: emulator timings vary too much to fail on them.
Set on 19 Nov 2026 from the first smoke runs on the Android 17 emulator: login 85-93 s, login to logout 57-79 s, cold start 10-14 s, memory 500-545 MB. Adjust after a few more runs.

app._why: Instagram is a large app that loads its feed, stories and video players at start: 10-14 s and 500-545 MB on the emulator.

default._why: Every test logs in over the network (or checks the session), and each step waits for the UI to settle: 57-93 s seen.
